summary: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. filed a Form 6-K on April 23, 2026, reporting the results of its Ordinary Shareholders Meeting. The meeting elected a new Board of Directors for a two-year term, including independent directors, and appointed Ignacio Cueto Plaza as Chairman and Bornah Moghbel as Vice Chairman. A Directors Committee was formed to also serve as the Audit Committee under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act. This is a routine corporate governance update, not a special situation. No transaction, price, premium, or deal mechanics are involved.
